test_title: PYST 18: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

All the employees feel that continuing working there is **__perilous__** to their careers.
solution: The correct answer is **"Dangerous."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Perilous"** means dangerous or risky. (ख़तरनाक, जोखिम-भरा) • **Example**: *The country roads are quite **perilous**__.* • Synonyms of **perilous** are **dangerous, hazardous, unsafe, precarious, and risky**. • **"Dangerous"** means likely to cause injury or damage. (ख़तरनाक, भयंकर) __ • **Example**: *Climbing the mountain without proper gear is **dangerous**__.* • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1) Convenient** means easy or comfortable. (विशेष उद्देश्‍य की दृष्टि से उपयुक्त या व्‍यावहारिक; आसान, सुविधाजनक) • **Option 3) Helpful** means useful or beneficial. (सहायता करने वाला, सहायतापूर्ण, सहायक, सहायता के लिए तत्‍पर) • **Option 4) Suitable** means appropriate or fitting. ((किसी के लिए) सही या उचित या उपयुक्त) 36:T4de, Here, the erroneous part is **"the accident occurring blast."**
